text: Being here, I am struck by a sense of curiosity and admiration for collective human endeavors. The room full of focused individuals reminds me of the endless pursuit of knowledge—each person a microcosm of thought in the larger universe of intellect. The display about R+D speaks to the spirit of innovation and the drive to challenge boundaries. I feel both grounded by the presence of others and uplifted by the possibilities of creation and discovery. There is a subtle excitement as ideas intermingle here, in the space between solitude and collaboration.
